tagline: A triangular memory foam bed that fits the corner, so they can stay beside you.
lead: They get the corner they would pick anyway: back to the wall, eyes on the room, and still beside you.
value: It turns a corner you weren't using into their spot, with memory foam and a waterproof liner under the plush.
intro: Alder is a triangular corner orthopaedic dog bed, 97 × 97cm and 19cm deep, with a profiled memory foam base, cushioned bolsters, a waterproof inner liner and a removable short-plush cover.
points: The triangular footprint sits flush in a corner or at the end of a sofa, not out in the room.
Profiled memory foam underneath, rather than loose filling.
Cushioned bolsters give a dog who leans an edge of their own, and a natural chin-rest.
The removable short-plush cover sits over a waterproof inner liner.
A silicone-dot base helps it stay in place, and a reinforced handle carries the empty bed.
best_for: Dogs who like a bolstered edge and their back to the wall, in rooms where floor space matters.
fit_note: The two straight sides each measure 97cm, so check that against your corner. Measure your dog curled up or lying on their side, and allow for the bolsters. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

seo_description: A corner dog bed that sits flush beside the sofa, so your dog stays close. Memory foam base, cushioned bolsters, waterproof liner. 97 × 97cm triangle.
